    (coalesce(live_in_houseBioMother, 0) +

      coalesce(live_in_houseAdopFather, 0)) >=

  (coalesce(live_in_houseBioMother, 0) +
    coalesce(live_in_houseBioFather, 0) +
    coalesce(live_in_houseAdopMother, 0) +
    coalesce(live_in_houseAdopFather, 0)) >=

  (coalesce(live_in_houseBioMother, 0) +
    coalesce(live_in_houseBioFather, 0) +
    coalesce(live_in_houseAdopMother, 0) +

)
